description: This file contains Kotlin data classes and functions to parse error messages related to invoke errors, including extracting error codes, messages, and handling Throwable objects.

classes.name: ParsedInvokeError
classes.description: Data class representing a parsed invoke error with code, message, and a flag indicating if an explicit code was present.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw error message string into a ParsedInvokeError object, detecting error codes and messages.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Extracts and parses an error message from a Throwable object, providing a fallback message if necessary.
